references.text: Parallel list of unclean birds in the Mosaic Law, including the ostrich, the night hawk, the gull and the hawk - the same birds mentioned in Deuteronomy 14:15
Isaiah mentions the ostrich (bat hajja'anah) as one of the unclean birds that will dwell in desolate places, showing their status as unclean birds in Israelite thought
The prophecy about Babylon's destruction mentions ostriches (benot ja'anah) that will inhabit it, showing the connection between unclean birds and abandoned, desolate places
Job compares himself to a brother of jackals and a companion of ostriches, illustrating the ostrich's role in biblical imagery concerning wilderness and loneliness
